title: Reversible placemats
text: Reversible placemats. I purchased 4 different sets from this brand Counterart - the colors are bright and colorful - clear prints.  You get 4 - I wish there were 6 - but didn't want to purchase 8 (2 sets). Time will tell if they stand up to the wear -  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Winter Greenery Reversible Rectangular Placemat Set of 4 Made in The USA
description: Counterart Winter Greenery Reversible Rectangular Placemat Set of 4 Made in the USA. REVERSIBLE- Placemats are reversible and have different coordinating designs on both the front and back of each mat. Beautiful designs are great for everyday meals, parties and outdoor entertaining. MADE IN THE USA. BPA and PVC free flexible plastic. SURFACE PROTECTION & CARE- Placemats protect your table or counter from spilled food, scratches, or stains. Flexible and easy clean up. Funnel crumbs or meal remnants easily from the table to the trash receptacle. Then wipe the placemat clean with soap and water. ARTISTIC DESIGNS- Beautiful artistic designs allow you to change the look of your table, kitchen or dinning room quickly for any season or holiday. They are beautiful and great to display even when not in use. MEASURES- Each placemat measures 17.13” X 11.25”. Great size for plates, drinkware, and utensils to fit nicely
